notes.text: John Sherriff (Enron Europe) announced the formation of the Credit Markets Group, which develops products to manage risk in Enron's internal credit portfolio and to sell third-party credit protection; Anjam Ahmad forwarded it to the owner, Stinson Gibner and Vasant Shanbhogue.
The Credit Markets Group will start by making markets in bankruptcy protection on reference credits already in Enron's portfolio and expects to add more credit products and reference credits quickly.

The Credit Markets Group will use EnronOnline as its primary trade execution tool and will launch an external credit protection web site offering real-time prices, credit models and research papers; a public announcement was expected in late January.
The Credit Markets Group will be based in London, with an initial local desk in Houston.
Bryan Seyfried is moving out of RAC, where he ran the Trading Controls and Research teams in Europe, to lead the Credit Markets Group, reporting to John Sherriff.
